what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Plan allows rewriting or retaining retired .md contract files while also requiring those same .md paths in python/migrated-scripts.tsv
scenario_or_breakage: Retaining any listed .md file leaves a manifest path present on disk, so make lint-retired-scripts fails before reference scanning; it also contradicts the standard recipe to delete .md siblings
suggested_fix: Remove the rewrite or retain branches for the listed .md siblings; make them deletion-only, or move any still-needed contract text to a new non-retired path and do not list that surviving path in python/migrated-scripts.tsv
